item.coloph: de ltar bka' lung man ngag 'di/ yi ger btab pa mthol lo bshags/ ma sring tshogs la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i stobs nyid kyis/ pha ma'i gtsor byas sems can rnams/ nub phyogs o rgyan zhing khams su/ brdzus te skye ba len par shog kha ba can ljongs bod yul du/ g.yung drung bstan pa dar rgyas nas/ me tog 'phel bzhin bkra shis shog/
